name: bluepainter
description: Visual canvas ↔ code sync with AST preservation and Designer's Receipts for React/TSX

bluepainter.demoUrl.description: URL for the BluePainter web validation demo.

bluepainter.spacingGrid.markdownDescription: Designer Receipts spacing grid in pixels. Components should use padding/margin values that are multiples of this grid. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root. See [Configuration Guide](https://bluepainter-studio.vercel.app/#/docs) for details.

bluepainter.radiusGrid.markdownDescription: Designer Receipts border-radius grid in pixels. Components should use border-radius values that are multiples of this grid. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root.

bluepainter.minContrastRatio.markdownDescription: Minimum WCAG contrast ratio for button text/background. Default 4.5:1 meets WCAG AA standards. Error-severity receipts can block CI/CD if enabled. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root.

bluepainter.maxFeatureCount.markdownDescription: Maximum feature list items before clutter receipt fires. Helps maintain clean, focused UI by warning when feature lists exceed this count. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root.

bluepainter.weakCtaWords.markdownDescription: Weak CTA words that trigger conversion receipts. These generic terms are flagged for replacement with more specific, action-oriented copy. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root.

bluepainter.suggestedCta.markdownDescription: Suggested CTA copy shown in receipt fixes. Customize this to match your product's primary call-to-action. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root.

bluepainter.contrastFixColor.markdownDescription: Button background color applied by contrast fix (hex color). Should meet WCAG AA contrast ratio when paired with white text. For team-wide settings, create a `.bluepainter.json` file in your repo root.

bluepainter.enableDesignSystemDetection.markdownDescription: Detect design systems and monorepos to show helpful tips. When enabled, BluePainter analyzes your workspace structure and suggests best practices for component organization and policy configuration.

scripts.package:
vsce package --no-dependencies && echo '
✅ Package created: bluepainter-0.2.0.vsix' && echo '
📦 Next steps:' && echo '   1. Test locally: code --install-extension bluepainter-0.2.0.vsix' && echo '   2. See MARKETPLACE.md for publishing instructions' && echo '   3. Or run: npm run publish:marketplace (requires vsce login)
'
